summary: Resume analyzer web application with advanced features including comprehensive data extraction, work experience parsing, skills/education/certifications extraction, and resume scoring
architectural_notes: PDF processing and text extraction for resume parsing
Data extraction pipeline for structured resume information

existing_features.title: Replace the mock AI parsing in aiResumeParser.ts with comprehensive extraction that captures contact information (phone, email, LinkedIn, location), professional summary, certifications with issuing organizations and dates, and languages with proficiency levels

Enhance work experience parsing to extract detailed information including job titles, company names, employment dates (start and end), location, and bullet-point descriptions of responsibilities and achievements for each position

Implement a resume scoring and analysis system that evaluates resumes based on completeness (presence of all sections), content quality (description detail, quantifiable achievements), formatting consistency, and skill relevance to common job requirements, displaying an overall score out of 100 with breakdown by category

Redesign the results display page with a modern, professional UI featuring a card-based layout with clear visual hierarchy, section headers with icons, improved typography and spacing, color-coded skill tags, and responsive design that adapts gracefully to mobile devices
Enhance the education section extraction to capture degree type, field of study, institution name, graduation date, GPA (if present), and relevant coursework or honors

Improve skills extraction to categorize skills into Technical Skills (programming languages, frameworks, tools), Soft Skills (communication, leadership, teamwork), and Domain Skills (industry-specific knowledge), with automatic proficiency level inference based on years of experience and context

new_feature_requests.summary: Comprehensive data extraction from resume PDFs
Detailed work experience parsing with job titles, companies, dates, and descriptions
